pages.raw_text:
Asp.Net Core – True Ultimate Guide
Section 27 – Swagger – Cheat Sheet
Introduction to Swagger
Swagger is a set of open-source tools that help developers to generate interactive UI to document,
test RESTful services.
Swagger is a set of tools to implement Open API.
1. Swasbuckle.AspNetCore
Framework that makes it easy to use swagger in asp.net core.
2. Swagger
Set of tools to generate UI to document & test RESTful services.
3. Open API
Specification that defines how to write API specifications in JSON).
API Versions
API Versioning is the practice of transparently managing changes to your API, where the client
requests a specific version of API; and the server executes the same version of the API code.

Content negotiation is the process of selecting the appropriate format or language of the content to
be exchanged between the client (browser) and Web API.
